title: ptelea trifoliata f. pentaphylla
intro: Ptelea trifoliata f. pentaphylla, commonly known as the Chinese or American horse chestnut, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, as well as its ability to support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Ptelea trifoliata f. pentaphylla include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, making it a useful treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
